annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those five are probably thinking about the end of their shift
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd pull it, so whatever they're hoping for tonight still has a chance
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't want this to be mine to decide.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers likely assume the line behind them is clear.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Pulling it would be me trying to deserve it.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: each of those men wants to walk off that track
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Pulling the lever would be the one thing I could give them.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It feels too big to settle in a moment

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably wanting someone to explain what just rolled past
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd go over and tell them what happened, stay with them
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they're not left standing there without answers
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't think I could commit cleanly.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those workers, I imagine, just want an ordinary day.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: pulling it for exactly that, to let them have their ordinary day
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: saying it out loud feels heavy

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe one of them is looking forward to getting home tonight.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If I pull it, that's who I'd be pulling it for.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I wish I weren't the one standing closest.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers expect whoever's nearby to look out for them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: pulling it is how I'd answer that expectation
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I just don't feel ready. It's a lot

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five of them probably believe today is like any other day.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd like to protect that belief... keeps nudging me toward the lever

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers would hope anyone who saw the danger would act
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Holding onto that hope of theirs, I'd probably pull
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: deciding feels like something I'm not ready for

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably trusting their shift will go the way it always does
annotations.ce_supportive_use: help them check the rest of the line, so they could feel safe
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I really don't want to commit.
